scope.flow: ERC-4337 user operation signature validation via AtomWallet._validateSignature and EntryPoint.validateUserOp
scope.environment: AtomWallet account contract with ERC-4337 EntryPoint

entities.name: User operation signed with high-s ECDSA signature
Wallet software, bundler, or attacker producing/malleating high-s signature

statements.text: A user operation is signed with a high-s ECDSA signature where s > secp256k1n/2.
ECDSA.tryRecover returns RecoverError.InvalidSignatureS for the high-s signature.
AtomWallet._validateSignature processes the user operation signature.
EntryPoint.validateUserOp invokes the account's signature validation.
_validateSignature reverts with AtomWallet_InvalidSignatureS on InvalidSignatureS instead of returning SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED.
EntryPoint.validateUserOp propagates the revert, breaking the account abstraction flow for the user operation.
The high-s-signed user operation is permanently blocked from being processed through the EntryPoint.
_validateSignature must never revert and must return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED for any invalid signature, as ERC-4337 mandates.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether a high-s signature was actually observed in a live transaction; scenario is conditional.
Whether the signer is a legitimate wallet/bundler or an attacker mallating a low-s signature is not determined.
Dead-code claim about InvalidSignatureLength branch is noted but not extracted as a separate harm.
